label: Bit vectors ordered componentwise
subgoals: Compare two vectors bit by bit
Read the interval between them as the bits that may change
Raise 2 to the number of free bits

label: Functions ordered by implication
subgoals: Check that the ON-set of f lies inside the ON-set of g
Count the rows in g but not in f
Count the functions between f and g as 2 to that number

label: Join and meet of functions
subgoals: Take the OR of two functions as their join
Take the AND as their meet
Count the ON rows of each
